newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha trims losses with crude rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha trims losses with crude rally.

text.p: NWE naphtha trimmed losses with the sharp rally in crude, but still ended down slightly as end user demand appeared well satisfied until the second half of the month, traders said.
"End users are covered well into November so there is no need to look at naphtha purchases," one said. "It's fairly balanced."

One industry source said Brazil may be interested in buying one of the two large cargoes heading to northwest Europe from the Med that were set to be loaded in Nov 1-10. Each cargo is about 60,000 tonnes out of Skikda.
